script_note: One academic-local route selects OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv, Semantic Scholar, PubMed, or public Scholar providers by coverage. SerpApi Scholar is an explicit optional credentialed provider. academic_public.py reads selected public metadata and HTML evidence.
source_requirement: Discovery metadata and snippets locate papers; paper-brief and detailed claims require selected-paper sources, with the primary PDF or body for exact claims.
agent_rule: One academic Agent runs bundled discovery, selects papers, reads public metadata and available primary sources, and interprets evidence.
